title: Runs: 40 real rack runs of CAN 12 and CAN 14
source: /archive/datasets/bam_rig rack_2026-10-24 and rack_2026-10-25 (real runs), replayed through each motor's twin by sim2real dashboards/source/rack_replays.py (bam_rack_twin); written by gallery/examples/robotics-servo/source/build.py

fields.name: run
fields.title: Run
fields.description: day/folder/session under the rack's archive: a stable, unique id

fields.name: started
fields.title: Started at
fields.description: ISO 8601, the rig's local time with its offset

fields.name: when
fields.title: Started
fields.description: started, as the table shows it (the rig's local time)

fields.name: twin
fields.title: Twin
fields.description: the twin's version, rebuilt as its motor's dataset file names it

fields.name: q_rms_mrad
fields.title: Twin q RMS
fields.description: real − twin, RMS over the rows both were in position mode (scorecard.score_replay's), at the full logged rate

fields.name: held_out
fields.title: Held out
fields.description: a held-out row of its motor's dataset file (whose twin_q_rms_mrad.full the replay reproduces)

fields.name: npz
fields.title: Run file
fields.description: the run's npz in the rack's archive
